items.q: Can I cancel if my plans change?
items.a: Most tours can be cancelled up to 24h before the tour starts for a full refund. No forms, no questions asked. Cancel straight from your confirmation email.

items.q: Do I have to pay in full now?
items.a: No — you can secure your spot with just 20% upfront and pay the remaining balance closer to your tour date.
We're a team of islanders who grew up on Curaçao, Aruba, and Sint Maarten. Every tour is one we've personally vetted.

items.q: What if my tour gets cancelled?
items.a: If a tour is cancelled by the operator, you get a full refund within 24 hours — no questions asked.

items.q: Not sure which tour? We'll help.
items.a: Chat with us on WhatsApp anytime. Tell us what you're after and we'll give you honest, local recommendations.

about.title: About tours in {destination}
about.description: Every {destination} tour on Island Tours is picked by people who live here. We ride the tours ourselves, write each description from experience, and show the full price up front, with no surprise fees at checkout. Most tours hold your spot with a small deposit rather than the whole amount, and every one of them can be cancelled free within the window shown on its page. Booking is instant, so your confirmation arrives straight away, and if anything is unclear before you travel we answer on WhatsApp from 08:00 to 20:00.
